bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 AM PST THIS MORNING... Combined seas 10 to 11 feet this morning, decreasing to 7 to 9 feet by this afternoon. Bar conditions severe becoming rough, becoming moderate in the afternoon. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 1030 AM Tuesday, 1000 PM Tuesday, and 1130 AM Wednesday.
